title: The same picture book, rebuilt with React
changes: Migrated all page rendering, forms, widgets, library and extractor UI to React while preserving the original decorative theme.
Added Vite and prefixed Tailwind utilities without a global styling reset.
Moved API routing to Express while retaining PostgreSQL services, authentication, validation and revision-safe saves.
Added browser workflow and visual comparison checks, production builds and same-origin development.
Rewrote the README as a short introduction and moved setup material to development documentation.

title: Reliable saves and a smaller request reader
changes: Documented the selected React/Vite, Node.js/Express and Tailwind migration plan for the whole app, including visual-preservation checks; implementation has not started.
Fixed Windows launcher escaping so Docker Desktop can start automatically; clarified that --check does not start services.
Fixed manual bookmarks silently succeeding when a pending automatic save loses authorization or conflicts with another device.
Skip malformed EPUB image URLs while keeping readable chapters and valid local illustrations.
Share request-size enforcement between JSON writes and binary uploads, and reject invalid JSON media types.
Added regression checks and recorded the code review, verification, and remaining limits.

title: A voice for the reading room
changes: Added free local-device read-aloud with playback controls, voice/speed selection, word or sentence highlights, and optional follow scrolling.
Read across pages and save spoken positions while stopping old playback on manual navigation.
Added PDF text overlays for selectable-text reading and Left, Center, Right, and Justify novel alignment.
Save alignment and voice preferences per book in PostgreSQL.

title: A reader that remembers your place
changes: Removed shelf Rename buttons while retaining title/folder editing inside the reader.
Added novel-only font choices saved with each book's reading preferences.
Automatically save page and viewport/text positions, with immediate manual saving and latest-save priority.
Prepared a lightweight browser-voice TTS plan for approval; playback is not implemented yet.

title: Whole sentences and familiar covers
changes: Keep EPUB sentences together across page breaks, including inline formatting.
Added shelf Rename controls that save novel titles in PostgreSQL.
Preview embedded EPUB covers or the first PDF page on hover or keyboard focus.

title: A title and a page to return to
changes: Paginate EPUB text and illustrations with continuous Title - Page navigation.
Use table-of-contents titles only, including anchors within a source file.
Keep page controls and a next-title jump below the text, with stable page bookmarks.

title: Chapter names and one more chapter
changes: Read EPUB chapter titles from EPUB 3 navigation, EPUB 2 NCX, or chapter headings.
Added previous/next chapter controls below the reading text, with page controls for PDF.
Preserved original reading order and existing bookmarks.

title: A reading room for whole series
changes: Added private PDF and EPUB uploads, original-file downloads, and format-specific reading controls.
Added series folders, folder management, and moving or renaming volumes.
Save PDF page and EPUB section bookmarks and include files and folders in backups.

title: A bigger hello from our mascot
changes: Enlarged the header lettering and Picture Book subtitle.
Made the mascot substantially larger, with separate space below the logo on smaller screens.

title: A soundtrack for every visitor
changes: Show the owner's Music of the Day to visitors even with a private profile.
Keep music editing owner-only and clarify public song visibility.

title: Open the notebook with one click
changes: Added a Windows launcher for Docker, PostgreSQL, the website, and browser opening.
Added everyday startup and PostgreSQL table-viewing instructions.

title: A fuller corner and a clearer forecast
changes: Keep default profile copy visible when new account fields are empty.
Added an owner-only editor beside In my little world.
Fixed the weather loading null-property error and added city/region selection and clearer recovery messages.

title: Quiet owner access
changes: Moved sign-in to an unlinked owner page and kept remembered session access.
Hide editing, music inputs, uploads, backups, and trash from public visitors before initialization.
Keep authenticated server permissions while showing visitors only reading controls.

title: Clearer music sign-in controls
changes: Allow pasting music links while signed out and explain that saving requires owner sign-in.
Preserve pasted links when signing in and update controls when a session expires.
Reject local-file URLs in music covers and links.

title: Clearer database migration diagnostics
changes: Report specific database connection and permission errors without exposing credentials.
Added connection diagnostics and a verified local Compose migration-configuration helper.
Fixed local migration configuration to use the administrator while preserving the restricted runtime connection.

title: A notebook with a PostgreSQL home
changes: Added PostgreSQL schema, migrations, restricted database grants, and owner setup commands.
Moved notebook authoring, imported books, and bookmarks to an authenticated server API.
Added private defaults, explicit publishing, recoverable trash, and revision conflict checks.
Added validated transactional imports from legacy browser backups with safe retry receipts.
Added PostgreSQL/API integration tests and updated setup and reference documentation.

title: Getting a little melody to the pages
changes: Added a YouTube link input and load button to retrieve video title, channel name, and thumbnail.
Added GET /api/music-info with video-ID validation, JSON responses, and a ten-second upstream timeout.
Fixed title/artwork updates and preserved the title, channel, thumbnail, and listening URL across reloads and profile edits.
Replaced inactive playback controls with a Listen on YouTube link and corrected the widget help text.
Added metadata validation, clear API/storage failure messages, and music persistence/API regression coverage.
Revised the existing music version note, code reference, and project report to describe the completed fixes and remaining limits.

title: Ordinary HTML again
changes: Moved complete page layouts into normal editable HTML files.
Moved repeated cards, forms, reader controls, and widget results into shared HTML templates.
Separated JavaScript behaviour from markup in both browser scripts.
Preserved saved notebook data and added an HTML editing guide with updated checks.

title: Back to an anime homepage
changes: Reworked the design into a compact 2010-era anime homepage with a gingham frame and pastel directory.
Restored the jumping multicoloured logo and character-image zoom with keyboard and reduced-motion support.
Reorganised pages, runtime assets, tests, and archive data into dedicated folders.
Added desktop, tablet, phone, and touch layouts, including responsive extractor panels.
Added a complete project report, function reference, and future update plan.

title: A picture book finds its pages again
changes: Rebuilt the home page around the original fonts, character illustrations, and warm paper palette.
Added daily notes, blog and story writing, document links, a work board, and a personal anime log.
Added calendar reminders, optional location-based weather, and local music playback.
Built a local text-novel library with folder import, reading controls, and bookmarks.
Preserved the original AI2D page and added notebook backup and restore.
Added a public-content export for static hosting that excludes the private notebook sections.
